description: Save the complete ordered list of native and custom block IDs in an email. A changed block list is refused.

dry_run.description: True validates without saving. False validates and saves one undoable change.

expected_seq.description: Latest workspace sequence returned by a read. A stale sequence is refused.

request_id.description: Unique ID for this change. Reuse it only when retrying the identical operation.

theme_id.description: An owned theme ID returned by list_themes, copy_theme or create_custom_theme.

name: reorder_blocks
title: Reorder email blocks
